shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- App ---\\n' && cat src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- main ---\\n' && cat src/main.tsx && printf '\\n--- routing excerpt ---\\n' && sed -n '1,90p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && printf '\\n--- traps dropdown ---\\n' && rg -n -C 3 \"Dropdown|Button view|variant\" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && printf '\\n--- uikit dropdown docs ---\\n' && rg -n -C 5 \"Dropdown\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/Dropdown.md 2>/dev/null || rg -n -C 5 \"Dropdown\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs -g '*.md' | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- README dropdown ---'; rg -n -C 6 \"Dropdown\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -120; printf '%s\\n' '--- declaration files ---'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -iname '*Dropdown*' -maxdepth 5 | head -30; printf '%s\\n' '--- dropdown types ---'; rg -n \"DropdownMenu|DropdownProps|type Dropdown|declare .*Dropdown\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/**/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.d.ts; printf '\\n--- context ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenuContext.d.ts; printf '\\n--- exports ---\\n'; rg -n \"DropdownMenu|components/DropdownMenu\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts; printf '\\n--- button types ---\\n'; rg -n \"interface ButtonProps|type ButtonProps|view\\?\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -60"
